```{python}
from html import escape
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable

import yaml
from IPython.display import HTML, display


def safe_join(classes: Iterable[str]) -> str:
    """Une clases CSS filtrando valores vacíos."""
    return " ".join(cls for cls in classes if cls)


def safe_url(url: str | None) -> str | None:
    """Escapa URLs conservando comillas."""
    if not url:
        return None
    return escape(url, quote=True)


def render_repo_card(repo: dict) -> str:
    """Renderiza una tarjeta HTML para un repositorio."""
    title = escape(repo.get("name", "Repositorio sin nombre"))
    description = repo.get("description")
    repo_slug = repo.get("repo")
    github_url = repo.get("github_url") or (f"https://github.com/{repo_slug}" if repo_slug else None)
    website_url = repo.get("website")
    topics = repo.get("topics", [])
    status = repo.get("status")
    updated = repo.get("updated")
    extra_links = repo.get("links", [])
    highlight = repo.get("highlight")

    card_classes = safe_join(["repo-card", "repo-card--highlight" if highlight else ""])

    parts: list[str] = [f'<article class="{card_classes}">', '<header class="repo-card__header">']

    title_link = website_url or github_url
    if title_link:
        parts.append(
            f'<h3 class="repo-card__title"><a href="{safe_url(title_link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{title}</a></h3>'
        )
    else:
        parts.append(f'<h3 class="repo-card__title">{title}</h3>')

    link_items: list[str] = []
    if github_url:
        link_items.append(f'<a class="repo-card__link" href="{safe_url(github_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Código</a>')
    if website_url and website_url != github_url:
        link_items.append(f'<a class="repo-card__link" href="{safe_url(website_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Sitio</a>')

    for link in extra_links:
        link_url = safe_url(link.get("url"))
        link_text = escape(link.get("text", "Enlace"))
        if link_url:
            link_items.append(f'<a class="repo-card__link" href="{link_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">{link_text}</a>')

    if link_items:
        parts.append('<div class="repo-card__links">' + " · ".join(link_items) + "</div>")

    parts.append("</header>")

    if description:
        parts.append(f'<p class="repo-card__description">{escape(description)}</p>')

    if topics:
        topics_html = "".join(f"<li>{escape(str(topic))}</li>" for topic in topics)
        parts.append(f'<ul class="repo-card__topics">{topics_html}</ul>')

    meta_items: list[str] = []
    if status:
        meta_items.append(f'<span class="repo-card__status">{escape(status)}</span>')
    if updated:
        meta_items.append(f'<span class="repo-card__updated">Actualizado {escape(updated)}</span>')

    if meta_items:
        parts.append('<footer class="repo-card__meta">' + " · ".join(meta_items) + "</footer>")

    parts.append("</article>")

    return "".join(parts)


data_path = Path("data") / "repositorios.yml"

if not data_path.exists():
    display(
        HTML('<div class="repo-warning">No se encontró <code>data/repositorios.yml</code>. Crea el archivo para listar proyectos.</div>')
    )
else:
    repo_data = yaml.safe_load(data_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
    sections_html: list[str] = []

    for section in repo_data.get("sections", []):
        repositories = section.get("repositories", [])
        if not repositories:
            continue

        section_id = escape(section.get("id") or section.get("title", "repos").lower().replace(" ", "-"))
        section_title = escape(section.get("title", ""))
        section_description = section.get("description")

        cards_html = "".join(render_repo_card(repo) for repo in repositories)

        section_parts = [f'<section class="repo-section" id="{section_id}">']
        if section_title:
            section_parts.append(f'<h2 class="repo-section__title">{section_title}</h2>')
        if section_description:
            section_parts.append(f'<p class="repo-section__description">{escape(section_description)}</p>')
        section_parts.append(f'<div class="repo-grid">{cards_html}</div>')
        section_parts.append("</section>")

        sections_html.append("".join(section_parts))

    if sections_html:
        display(HTML("\n".join(sections_html)))
    else:
        display(
            HTML('<div class="repo-warning">No hay repositorios configurados en <code>data/repositorios.yml</code>.</div>')
        )
```
